lines.zh: 一大群脚步碾过碎石路。
lines.en: A whole crowd of feet grinds over the gravel.

lines.zh: 尸群里，一只拖着断腿走。
lines.en: One of the horde drags a broken leg.
Stand still, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 我站在废墟口，等同伴聚齐。
lines.en: I wait at the ruins' mouth for the pack to gather.
Slow breath, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 我蹲在断墙下听活人的脚步。
lines.en: I crouch by the broken wall, listening for footsteps.

lines.zh: 我们挤成一堆，谁都不出声。
lines.en: We stand packed together, none of us making a sound.
Silent stand, waiting for an opportunity.
Stare at the player, waiting for an opening.

lines.zh: 一群行尸挤在一起发愣。
lines.en: The horde stands packed together, blank-eyed.
We wait for night and the smell of blood.
Torn clothes flap in the wind.

lines.zh: 喉咙里挤出干涩的呼噜。
lines.en: A dry rattle scrapes out of our throats.

lines.zh: 最前面那只喉咙动了一下。
lines.en: The one in front moves its throat.
Sharp gaze, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 墙后面有一整批脚步声。
lines.en: A whole batch of footsteps behind the wall.
Fix gaze on the player, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 几十双眼睛从废墟后转过来。
lines.en: Dozens of eyes turn from behind the ruins.
Steady gaze, fixing on the prey.
Sharp gaze, searching for the player.
I stare at you; the horde is behind me.

lines.zh: 几十双眼睛同时转过来。
lines.en: Dozens of eyes turn at once.
The smell of blood drifts from your side.
The horde halts and stares at you together.

lines.zh: 你咳了一声，我们全听见了。
lines.en: You coughed once; we all heard it.

lines.zh: 最前面那只先认出了你。
lines.en: The one in front recognizes you first.
We close in, tightening the ring.
Your breathing is far too clear.
Through the ruins, I smell you.

lines.zh: 黑血从嘴角流到衣襟上。
lines.en: Black blood runs from my mouth onto my rags.

lines.zh: 伤口触目惊心，痛得要命！
lines.en: Wound is gaping, hurts like a bitch!

lines.zh: 我的小腿被砍断，爬着跟。
lines.en: My shin is cut through; I crawl after you.

lines.zh: 伤口鲜血直流，痛得厉害！
身上伤痕累累，痛苦难当！

lines.en: What do you want to eat?

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？腐肉的香味！
lines.en: Smell it, the stench of decay!

lines.zh: 你的伤口比腐肉香多了。
lines.en: Your wound smells far better than rot.
The horde shoves in, and you lose your footing.
The whole pack came with me.
You block my path, you must die.

lines.zh: 尸群已经围上来了，让开。
lines.en: The horde is closing in. Move.

lines.zh: 找到另一个，我们可以一起走！
lines.en: Find another, we can go together.

lines.zh: 找个伴儿，可以一起战斗！
lines.en: Find a partner, we can fight together.

lines.zh: 我们需要一个生存伙伴！
找个伴儿，一起寻找食物！
lines.en: Find a partner, we can find food together.
Find a partner, we can move forward together.

lines.zh: 尸群里不分彼此，都算同伴。
lines.en: In the horde we are all one, all kin.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤发出声响，像是饥饿的低吟。
丧尸的骨架吱吱作响，引诱着猎物。
腐肉发出恶臭，招来同伴加入。
腐烂的肢体敲打着地面，寻找猎物。
腐烂的牙齿咬合，渴望血液。
僵尸的低语混杂着饥饿的声音。
腐烂的尸体吸引附近的同类。
腐烂的肌肉蠕动，寻找新的猎物。
腐烂的血液在伤口中流淌。
腐烂的手指摸索着，寻找猎物。
发现了猎物，饥饿的嚎叫响起。
猎物的气息勾起了食欲。
猎物的声音引来了饥饿的欲望。
注视猎物，饥渴的双眼闪烁。
闻到了猎物的气息，饥渴难耐。
盯上猎物，饥饿的视线紧锁。
嗅到了猎物的气味，饥肠辘辘。
饥饿的双眼盯紧了猎物。
饥饿的呼吸中充满了对猎物的渴望。
lines.en: Breath full of hunger for prey.

lines.zh: 饥饿的舌头舔着嘴唇，渴望猎物。
lines.en: Tongue licks lips, hungering for prey.
A whole living man, enough to share.
You run, and we run after.
Someone is breathing in the ruins.
That sound belongs to the living.

lines.zh: 咬上一口就多一个同伴。
lines.en: One bite and we gain another.

lines.zh: 饥饿的肌肉紧绷，瞄准猎物。
饥饿的舌头舔着嘴唇，瞄准猎物。
饥饿的双手寻找猎物，锁定目标。
饥饿的双眼紧盯着猎物。
饥饿的呼吸中充满对猎物的渴望。
lines.en: Breath full of hunger for prey.

lines.zh: 饥饿的舌头舔着嘴唇，锁定目标。
先围住他的腿，别让他跑。
lines.en: Ring his legs first so he cannot run.
We make a ring you cannot leave.
Grab him, do not let him climb.

lines.zh: 你被咬的地方会烂上几天。
lines.en: Where I bite, it will rot for days.
Hold him until the rest arrive.
Pin the arms first, then bite.
The whole horde falls on you.
I brought a whole crowd behind me.
I haul you down by the collar!
I tear a long gash open!
Hot blood runs into my mouth.
One bite each, take your share!
Hold him down, do not let go!
Here, there, the horde rises around you.

lines.zh: 废墟后翻出十几个身影。
lines.en: A dozen shapes climb out behind the ruins.

lines.zh: 它们从各个方向一起出现。
lines.en: They appear from every direction at once.

lines.zh: 这片野地忽然挤满了人。
lines.en: The open ground suddenly fills with bodies.
The horde stands up in rows at night.
One falls, a whole group stands.
They come out of the abandoned convoy.

lines.zh: 脚步声从四面八方来了。
着火了，皮肉烧得卷起来。
lines.en: I am on fire; my flesh curls black.

lines.zh: 从废墟上摔下来，腿断了。
lines.en: I fell off the ruins and broke my leg.
Water fills my lungs; I make no sound.
The blast took half my face.
An arrow is stuck in me and will not come out.

lines.zh: 那股怪力撕开了我的胸口。
lines.en: That strange force tore my chest open.
Hunger has left me a bare frame.
Lightning struck; my bones are charred.

lines.zh: 一直往下掉，什么都抓不住。
lines.en: I fall and fall with nothing to grab.
